name: CTSpinoPelvic1K v11 (the consortium's own release)
what: 802 CT volumes from TCIA sources with vertebra, sacrum and pelvis labels (Zenodo 22797014)
level_truth: vertebra, sacrum and pelvis labels by level; L6 cases flagged

segmentations.masks: vertebra masks from C1 to L6, each named by level, from CTSpine1K's radiologists; the sacrum and both hips, expert where fused and automatic elsewhere; the ribs, automatic and corrected by hand; L6 flags, and Castellvi reads on 33 cases, as labels/<id>_label.nii.gz with manifest.json
vertebra masks and body masks, each vertebra named by level
segmentations.by: the owner's runs, automatic (SPINEPS); no radiologist has read them

segmentations.masks: vertebra masks by TotalSegmentator and by SPINEPS with VERIDAH, each vertebra named by level, and the level call made from the two together
segmentations.by: the data platform's anomaly harvest, automatic; no radiologist has read them

licence: labels CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; the CT images CC BY 3.0 (TCIA)
how_to_get: Held: on the grid at /rs/rs_grp_oschome/go2432/data/ctspinopelvic1k, built and published by the consortium; the labels from Zenodo v11, 2026-09-18; nothing to fetch.
To share it with collaborators, copy it into /rs/rs_grp_oschome/shared/datasets/ctspinopelvic1k/ with its checksums as a Slurm job, as the pig set of #22 was copied, and note the job in the history.
source_status: held on the grid under the owner's data root, as SchwingNet's registry records it on 2026-10-23

history.note: on the grid at /rs/rs_grp_oschome/go2432/data/ctspinopelvic1k, built and published by the consortium; the labels from Zenodo v11, 2026-09-18, before the shared tree and its promoter existed; the record written for the census (#178) from SchwingNet's registry
